gloss: accent; dialect influence; regional speech pattern

definitions.gloss: accent; dialect influence; regional speech pattern
definitions.explanation: The distinctive pronunciation, intonation, or speech patterns that indicate someone's regional origin. Refers to how standard language is pronounced differently due to regional influence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はな}し{方|かた}→話し方：15767_hanashikata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{訛|なま}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: He has an accent in his speech.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んで→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{訛|なま}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}けない→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧。
examples.english: Even though I've lived in Tokyo for a long time, I still can't shake my accent.

notes:
DERIVED FROM:
The verb {訛|なま}る (to speak with an accent, to pronounce differently from standard).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {訛|なま}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ - to have an accent
- {訛|なま}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}けない→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧ - can't lose one's accent
- {訛|なま}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ - to have a strong accent
- {訛|なま}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ - accent comes out (unintentionally)

USAGE:
{訛|なま}り focuses on pronunciation differences from standard, while ⟦{方言|ほうげん}→方言：07419_hougen⟧ encompasses all aspects of regional language including vocabulary and grammar.

RELATED WORDS:
- {訛|なま}る - to speak with an accent (verb)
- ⟦{方言|ほうげん}→方言：07419_hougen⟧ - dialect (broader term)
- ⟦{標準語|ひょうじゅんご}→標準語：07421_hyoujungo⟧ - standard language
- ⟦イントネーション→イントネーション：25970_intoneeshon⟧ - intonation

CULTURAL NOTE:
{訛|なま}り can sometimes be a source of self-consciousness when speaking with people from other regions, but it's also often a point of regional pride and identity.

REGISTER:
Neutral. Common in everyday conversation.
